{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Mississippi Hub Storage Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Mississippi Hub storage facility, Simpson County, Mississippi to interconnects with Southeast Supply Header and Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line, Mississippi.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2009-07-24/pdf/E9-17695.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Mississippi Hub LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''200 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''36.8 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2009-07-24/pdf/E9-17695.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24, 30 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2009-07-24/pdf/E9-17695.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$75,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
